title.zh: Aave Labs Proposes Foundation to Bring Brand and IP Under DAO Oversight
title.en: Aave Labs Proposes Foundation to Bring Brand and IP Under DAO Oversight

current_state.zh: Aave Labs proposed creating a Cayman Islands foundation with independent officers as a first phase toward transferring Aave's brand, trademarks, domains and codebase to DAO governance, with the actual asset transfers subject to later governance votes.
current_state.en: Aave Labs proposed creating a Cayman Islands foundation with independent officers as a first phase toward transferring Aave's brand, trademarks, domains and codebase to DAO governance, with the actual asset transfers subject to later governance votes.
